claims.text: In Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937), the Queen addresses the mirror as 'Magic mirror on the wall', not 'Mirror, mirror on the wall'.
The Queen's line in the film is 'Magic mirror on the wall, who is the fairest one of all?'
Walt Disney received an honorary Academy Award for Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, made up of one full-size statuette and seven miniature ones.
